reuse.why: No link-rule helper existed; the change introduces one and calls it from each existing provider link function using the existing db helpers.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only a short call is repeated in each of the five pre-existing per-provider link copies, which the diff leaves as they were.

placement.why: The check sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link functions and runs before any mutation in each of them.

scope.why: Only the link functions and the new guard change.

maintainability.why: One clear guard, though each provider passes its sync-source as a free string and a new provider must remember to call it because the link bodies remain copied.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five provider link functions.
